Brain damage (intraventricular hemorrhage or periventricular leukomalacia)
outcome: Correlation between NfL and birth weight, gestational age, and other factors
cohort: Two cohorts of newborn infants: 203 term and preterm infants (cohort 1) and 98 preterm infants (cohort 2)
finding: Neonatal NfL levels are inversely correlated with gestational age and birth weight, increase in the first week of life, and are associated with brain injury factors and vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: NfL levels were positively correlated with vaginal delivery.
